context: Prep note. Customer: Brightline Logistics, contact Omar Katz. Current plan: hosting and maintenance, $1,800 per year, 3 support hours per month. Renewal quote sent: $2,100 per year because of added monitoring and security updates. Uptime was 99.95, so almost no downtime. Goal of the call: renew without a big discount. Any discount needs approval from the owner.

lines.text: Hi Omar, thanks for joining. Dana is on the line too, I think.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Hi Dan. Yes, Dana from finance is here, she wants to hear the numbers.
Good. I sent the renewal quote last week. I would like to walk through it with you.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I read it. Honestly I was surprised. Why did the price go up this year?
The new quote adds monitoring and security updates, which you did not have before.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Okay, but last year we paid $1,500, so this is a big jump.
Let me double check my records, I have $1,800 for the current plan.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Maybe that included the extra domain. Anyway, the real problem is another company offered the same thing for thirty percent less.
That is useful. What exactly does their offer include?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Hosting, backups and email support. I do not see monitoring in it, but the price is clearly lower.
So they do not include monitoring or the support hours we have in the plan.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Possibly. Can you match their price?
I cannot decide on a discount during the call. I will review options and come back to you.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Dan, quick one from me. What does the SLA say about response time?
The SLA is part of the contract, and I will send you the response times.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: And I would like to know how fast you react when the site is down at night.
The night response is covered in the SLA as well. I will include it.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Our CEO also says maintenance should be free after the first year. That is how the other company sells it.
Maintenance includes updates, security fixes and the support hours, so free is hard for us.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Then we would like something between the two. Do you have a smaller option?
I can prepare a short comparison of the plans.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: And will the invoice show monitoring as a separate line? I need it for the budget file.
I can split it into lines, yes. I will check how it looks in the invoice.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Also, what uptime did we have this year?
It was 99.95 this year, so no real downtime.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: And the plan has five hours of support per month, right?
It is three hours per month in the current plan, but we can discuss more.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Hmm. Another question. How long do you keep the backups, and can we restore a single file?
Good question. Let me come back to the backups after we finish the price.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Fine. Dana, can you pull last month's invoice for me?

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Sure, give me a minute.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Did you see the traffic on the highway this morning? I was stuck for forty minutes.
I heard, there was an accident near the interchange.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Yes, and then the coffee machine at the office was broken too.
Rough start to the day.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Dan, can you send me the plan comparison file?
Sure, I will send it after the call.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Okay, back to the renewal. If we sign this month, will you keep the price for two years?
I would like to offer that, but I need to check it first.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I will talk to our CFO and get back to you by Thursday.
Perfect. And I will send you the options and the SLA after this call.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Also, who signs on your side if we want changes to the contract?
The owner signs any contract change. I will bring your request to him.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Good. I also want a written summary of everything today, with the dates.
Yes, I will write a short summary for you.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: By the way, we are planning a new warehouse portal next year. Maybe you can help with that.
That sounds interesting. Let us finish the renewal and then I would like to hear more.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Sure. So what is next from your side?
I will send the options, the SLA and the answer on backups.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Please add the invoice copy too.
Of course. Thank you both.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Thanks Dan, bye.
